title: Run accountable sessions on Claude through a mediated file-only native boundary
goal: Deliver the minimal native Claude ExecutionBackend and discovery needed to run the accountable POC session on low-cost Anthropic models, leaving team operations, isolation and continuation to W6-0001.
scope: Implement native discovery and ExecutionBackend for the installed Claude Code stream-json control protocol. Preserve native authentication and agent identity, the observed provider version, per-model effort support and requested/sent/reported settings; a model without native effort support is offered with no effort rather than a translated one.

Offer files only through the host's InvocationFiles mediator over the same stdio control channel. Start the native process with no built-in tools, no ambient settings, plugins, slash commands or external tool servers, and treat the native init observation as an isolation assertion that stops the call when it differs.

Normalize input/cache-read/cache-write/output/reasoning usage to A13 from the final native result, with Complete coverage only for a consistent single-model final report. Stream loss, foreign tools, mismatched models and missing or inconsistent usage stay Partial or Unknown and never release holds.

Refuse continuation and team operations explicitly. Add a kernel parameter schema, discovery method and mediated-boundary recognition for this implementation, with its paragraph in the authoritative model.

Provide one protocol fixture exercised through the real Registry/Gatekeeper/host consumer, a native pilot example and a documented native-run procedure. Record native experiment evidence separately from fixtures.
acceptance: Through the real Registry/Gatekeeper/host consumer, a new Claude protocol fixture discovers offerings, runs a bounded admitted call with mediated read and write, returns attributable output and settles a correctly normalized receipt without copying authentication.

A foreign tool or isolation mismatch, a model mismatch, stream loss before the final result and incomplete usage are denied or recorded truthfully; none grants authority, repeats a start or releases an unresolved hold.

A bounded native run on the lowest-cost discovered Anthropic model records exact version, requested/sent/reported settings, finite limits, actual usage and unknown coverage, distinct from fixture and Scripted evidence.
context: Owner direction 2026-09-29: continue active development and run native experiments on light Anthropic models, balancing research speed against evidence quality. W6-0001 remains the full Claude adapter and is blocked by W3-0001; this task delivers only the file-mediated subset the W1 session needs.

Authority: model sections 3.1/3.4/3.7/3.9/5.1/5.7, A5/A13 and R-2/R-3/R-8/R-9/R-19/R-20. Fill the existing placeholder crates/ymp-runtime/src/backends/claude.rs and add focused protocol modules; derive every construct from the model and do not copy Codex adapter names or blocks.

Installed protocol facts were observed on Claude Code 2.1.284 with one metadata probe and one bounded claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 call (4407 input, 410 output tokens). The native tool updates itself, so the kernel binds the observed version through the discovery method instead of a fixed literal.
Fixture evidence is separate from real inference. Builds and tests start no model calls; native runs rely on the standing authorization in AGENTS.md with finite limits.
